async function stream(source, items) {
  for await (const item of source) {
    await save(item);
    for (const child of items) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await save(child);
    }
  }
  for (const item of items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await save(item);
  }
  await ready(); for (const item of items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await save(item);
  }
  for /* stream */ await (const item of source) {
    await save(item);
  }
}
